controls.title: Single agent trust root and instruction surface
controls.requirement: AGENTS.md is the only repository-wide AI-agent trust root and instruction surface. Repository-level provider instruction mirrors such as CLAUDE.md and .github/copilot-instructions.md remain absent.

controls.title: Agent capability plane is subordinate to repository governance
controls.requirement: ESS-0019 defines provider-neutral capability, risk, audit and execution-plane contracts; it is not a second repository trust root and cannot supersede AGENTS.md or manufacture Human/Owner authority.

controls.title: Stable authority identity
controls.requirement: Every new normative governance artifact has one immutable AUTH-* identity independent of path or display number.

controls.title: Deterministic scoped supersession and suspension
controls.requirement: Recency only orders versions of the same stable authority identity; cross-authority replacement requires explicit supersedes relation anchors plus machine-readable scope/condition/targets/exclusions and Owner-visible impact analysis. A bare supersedes authorityId never implies global replacement. Suspended, retired and historical artifacts remain traceable but non-authorizing.

controls.title: Unique active ADR and ESS namespaces
controls.requirement: No two active ADR or ESS artifacts may expose the same canonical display ID. ADR display IDs are reserved in docs/adr/registry.json before creation; active reservations are deterministic registry state and are converted or released after merge/close. Historical aliases remain explicit and non-authorizing.

controls.title: New or touched ADR registration
controls.requirement: Every new or materially migrated ADR is registered with stable authorityId, unique active displayId, version, date, lifecycle and supersession/alias metadata before merge-readiness.

controls.title: Deterministic ADR namespace reservation
controls.requirement: Before a new ADR is created its display ID is reserved in the existing ADR registry with displayId, branch, source, path, observedHead, state and reservedAt. Duplicate active reservations, an active record plus active reservation, malformed/stale reservations or unresolved reservation lifecycle are fail-closed. CI evaluates registry state only; live GitHub correlation is a separate preflight.

controls.title: Canonical document placement and lifecycle
controls.requirement: New governance, architecture, compliance, runbook, roadmap and evidence documents use their canonical docs domain and required lifecycle metadata; repository root Markdown is restricted to README.md and AGENTS.md; suspended artifacts live only in designated lifecycle/archive locations.

controls.title: Document roles and projection boundaries
controls.requirement: Registered document roles are explicit and machine-readable. Inventory and roadmap artifacts are non-normative; projections reference known active authorities; FRONTEND_ARCH is normative only for frontend-source-tree, frontend-dependencies and presentation-architecture and may not claim financial-runtime, market-data, scoring, ranking, financial-eligibility or runtime-evidence scope.

controls.title: Documentation hygiene is a reusable read-only service
controls.requirement: Documentation hygiene executes through src/platform/Documentary/Governance/Services/DocumentationHygieneValidator.ts and its CLI. It validates repository/document-registry structure read-only and does not become repository-wide authorization authority.

controls.title: Single platform-version authority and projections
controls.requirement: package.json#version is the sole platform-version authority. README and runtime/admin API values are deterministic/read-only projections. AGENTS.md Control Plane Version is independent governance metadata. uploads/version_manager.json, the legacy bump endpoint and automatic VersionManager ADR/compliance/document generation are non-authorizing and may not mutate current platform version or documentation.

controls.title: Historical evidence is retained but non-authorizing
controls.requirement: Suspended/superseded/retired/historical decisions, runbooks, evidence and reports remain traceable and may not silently regain current authority through age, location, prior ACCEPTED labels or citation. Explicit later Human Owner authority may alter current quota/state without rewriting immutable history.

controls.title: Governance integrity before feature readiness
controls.requirement: A feature may not become merge-ready while a correlated critical governance identity, authority or control-plane conflict remains unresolved.

controls.title: Fresh scoped and project-identifiable branch
controls.requirement: Repository changes are made only on a fresh scoped branch from current main; direct main edits are prohibited. Every new agent-managed work branch uses a permitted execution-prefix and the form <approved-agent-prefix>/<project-folder>-<compact-task>-<YYYYMMDD>, where project-folder is the canonical Primary-Owner project slug and compact-task is lowercase kebab-case identifying the bounded work item. Historical/merged/terminal branches are not renamed retroactively. A newly created non-conforming branch must be replaced by a fresh current-main conforming branch before protected work or PR readiness proceeds; branch naming never changes project ownership, Authority, merge authority or production permissions.

controls.title: Final main synchronization
controls.requirement: Immediately before requesting PR-creation approval, refresh main, correlate newly merged changes and open PR writers, synchronize the branch, resolve overlap and repeat necessary low-cost checks on the exact candidate snapshot.

controls.title: Explicit Owner approval before Pull Request creation
controls.requirement: A Pull Request or Draft Pull Request may be created only after final current-main synchronization/correlation and explicit Human/Owner approval bound to the reported main SHA and candidate head SHA. Any main or head change before creation invalidates the approval. During a valid ACTIVE ADR-0104 v1.4.0 PT8H session, repeated per-PR approval is replaced only for Human-directed work attributable to the exact bound chat, immutable authorized project set and current active project; main/head/open-writer/project-owner correlation remains mandatory and merge remains Human Owner-only.

controls.title: Chat handoff: bounded post-PR continuation and foreign-project routing
controls.requirement: This stable control has two triggers. POST_PR_HANDOFF preserves the bounded post-PR queue. FOREIGN_PROJECT_HANDOFF defaults to STOP, visible routing, REFERRED_NOT_EXECUTED and a complete copyable target-project prompt whenever productive work belongs to another canonical project or Primary Owner. During an ACTIVE ADR-0104 v1.4.0 session only, the STOP/separate-chat portion is conditionally replaced for a target already in the immutable one-to-three-project AUTHORIZED_PROJECT_SET. The same exact chat may continue only after a visible IN_SESSION_PROJECT_SWITCH, fresh current-main/slot/time/project/folder/owner/open-writer/overlap correlation, project-set digest verification and audit update; the set and PT8H end cannot change, and each project/work item uses its own branch and PR. Any project outside the set or unresolved/expired condition uses the full handoff and REQUIRES_CORRELATION fail-closed behavior. Generated prompts remain at most 400 lines per part.

controls.title: Timeboxed Human Owner delegated execution session
controls.requirement: ADR-0104 v1.4.0 binds each PT8H activation to one exact chat and an immutable predeclared set of one to three canonical projects. In-set movement requires a visible audited project switch, fresh membership/mapping/main/writer/overlap correlation and a separate project-scoped branch/PR. Projects cannot be added after activation. The current S1 expands from GOV to exactly GOV+OPS only if v1.4.0 is Human-merged before the unchanged 2026-09-02T02:46:32Z end; it does not gain device binding or duration. S2 remains CONSUMED and S3 AVAILABLE. Repeated PR-create and eligible protected-mutation approval prompts may be replaced only while ACTIVE. Human merge, out-of-set handoff, ownership, validation, provider authentication, secrets, assurance and truthful evidence remain controlling.

controls.title: Pre-PR evidence is non-authorizing
controls.requirement: Local or sandbox build/test evidence must be bound to the exact candidate SHA and never creates Human authority by itself. During a valid ADR-0104 session, authorization comes from the active chat/project-bound Human Owner delegation, not from test evidence.

controls.title: Independent hosted technical validation
controls.requirement: GitHub hosted build-and-test remains the independent technical check for the final PR head before merge when applicable. Successful hosted checks establish technical evidence only; the Human Owner still performs every Pull Request merge.

controls.title: M10 passkey runtime is retired and non-discoverable as a current implementation
controls.requirement: M10 AUTHORIZE_PR_CI productive runtime was retired by Human Merge of PR #691. Current-state repository, web-application, architecture, inventory, roadmap, agent and validation scans MUST NOT search for, expect, reconstruct or report the absence of a productive M10 implementation as a gap. Historical M10 artifacts/evidence may be inspected only for explicit audit/history requests and remain non-authorizing. Any future PR-CI/passkey authorization mechanism is a new separately Owner-authorized work item/authority decision; it MUST NOT be inferred as M10 reactivation from historical evidence. Human/CODEOWNER merge and normal current PR technical validation remain controlling.

controls.title: Human Owner-only Pull Request merge boundary
controls.requirement: Every Pull Request MUST be merged by the Human Owner through a distinct Human Owner merge action. Agent/chat self-merge, delegated merge execution, auto-merge enablement or equivalent automatic merge is prohibited. Green CI, reviews, labels, reactions, comments, elapsed time, PR metadata and ADR-0104 never constitute merge authority.

controls.title: Single verified production deployment authority
controls.requirement: Render native auto-deploy remains off; production promotion occurs through verified main CI, supply-chain attestation, exact-SHA deploy hook and post-deployment identity verification. A valid ACTIVE ADR-0104 v1.4.0 session may delegate execution of this existing path only for targets attributable to the current active project in its immutable authorized set; it does not create a second deployment authority or authorize targets outside that set.

controls.title: Reusable secrets stay outside evidence and model output
controls.requirement: Secrets, reusable credentials, private passkey material and raw sensitive tokens must not be committed or reproduced in model-visible evidence. ADR-0104 delegates mutations, not secret exfiltration or disclosure.

controls.title: Least privilege and fail-closed security ambiguity
controls.requirement: Protected workflows and external mutations preserve least privilege and fail closed on unresolved security-critical ambiguity. ADR-0104 v1.4.0 removes repeated approval prompts only inside one exact chat, an immutable predeclared one-to-three-project set and the current active project while a slot is ACTIVE. In-set switching requires fresh verification and audit; projects cannot be added during the session. The ADR does not remove target/project-owner verification, rollback/restore planning, provider authentication, out-of-set foreign-project routing, per-project branch/PR separation, finite slot semantics, Human Owner-only merge or fail-closed ambiguity handling.

controls.title: Governance continual improvement
controls.requirement: Governance controls are planned, implemented, evaluated and improved with dated evidence and explicit change ownership; external standards are mapped through a non-authorizing crosswalk rather than imported as a competing policy hierarchy.

controls.title: No unsupported certification or regulatory-status claims
controls.requirement: Engineering alignment to ISO/NIST or repository controls does not establish certification, regulated-entity status, high-risk AI classification or complete legal compliance without independent scope/evidence.
